E03 ran the real label-free ThresholdAllocator against LearnedAllocator at identical 750 verifier calls. Learned minus threshold admitted rate was +0.467, CI [+0.412, +0.491], so it favors the fixed rule. The threshold had no free labels, so the free-label confound is controlled and W2 is false. L3a, L3b and L3i agree. L3p's scaled-greedy pass failed L3s (percentile upper bound +0.0023). For claim 3, every later entry reuses E01's pool, so none counts as a different model, task or proxy, and kill is unavailable. No non-E01 entry shows a gain of 0.05 or a neighbor ratio of 1.5, so claim 3 is open and W3 is false.

E03 compares the real LearnedAllocator with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical 750 calls. Learned minus threshold admitted rate is +0.467, 95% CI [+0.412, +0.491], favoring the fixed rule, so the confound is controlled and claim 2 is not_supported. L3a, L3b and L3i agree. L3p briefly beat the threshold, but L3s's CI reached 0. Claim 3: every entry uses the same E01 pool, so no non-E01 entry exists to kill it. L3k shows embeddings-only AUC 0.60 and about +0.002 gain, with no gain of 0.05 or more and no neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more, so it is open. W2 and W3 are false.
